metadata.title: Retro Band Portrait with Metallic Script

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-person group portrait featuring a dark, moody background and a prominent, diagonally-oriented metallic script logo in the upper third.
triggerTerms: dark studio group photo with blue foil text

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men with 1970s-style hair and facial hair, arranged in a staggered formation against a black background, topped by a large, embossed blue metallic script title set on a diagonal axis.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal text overlaying a static group portrait
High-contrast lighting on subjects against a deep black void
Metallic texture of the logo contrasting with matte photographic skin tones
Staggered vertical arrangement of heads creating depth
coreInvariants: Metallic blue foil texture on display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a pyramid-like cluster occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright blue metallic script logo in the upper left to upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright blue script, follows the diagonal down to the central faces, then scans the surrounding band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subjects and behind the text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and earth-toned clothing
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright, saturated blue foil.

letterConstructionRules: Letters connected by a continuous baseline underline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'S' features a large, circular flourish that loops back into the stem
Terminal 'd' has a sharp, upward-pointing serif-like flick
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone decorative script; no secondary typography.

candidateDirections.reason: Formal script with extensive swash options

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group portrait of five men with 1970s hairstyles and mustaches, wearing western-style shirts, arranged in a staggered formation against a solid black studio background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, custom script title in the upper third, tilted upwards at a 15-degree angle. Apply a metallic blue foil texture with an embossed 3D effect and a continuous underline flourish.

verificationChecks: Is the text oriented on a diagonal?
Does the text have a metallic blue foil appearance?
Are the subjects styled in 1970s fashion?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue foil has a believable sheen.
Ensure the diagonal text does not obscure the faces.
Verify the 1970s aesthetic is consistent across all subjects.
Confirm the background is deep black without artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a dark studio group portrait and overlay a high-contrast, diagonal metallic script logo to create a vintage album cover look.
